brief:
An Israeli drone strike on the al-Mawasi area of Khan Younis in southern Gaza killed a Palestinian man and wounded two others, Al Jazeera reported, citing sources in the enclave.

The strike targeted the southern Gaza district on an unspecified date. No further details about the identities of those killed or wounded, or the circumstances of the strike, were immediately available.
dek: Israeli strike kills Palestinian man, wounds two others in Gaza A Palestinian man has been killed and two others wounded after Israeli forces carried out a drone strike on the al-Mawasi area of Khan Younis in southern Gaza, Al Jazeera reported, citing sources…
title: Israeli drone strike kills Palestinian in Khan Younis
